verdict.rationale: EFTPS's core transaction is federal tax payment, and its own pages document that payments can be made online 24/7. Users can pay income, employment, estimated and excise taxes, schedule payments up to 365 days ahead, change or cancel them, and get immediate acknowledgement. The main caveat is onboarding: enrollment ends with a PIN sent by U.S. Mail in 5–7 business days, so a founder's first payment cannot happen end-to-end online. New individual enrollments are also closed. Missing for 10: a fully online enrollment path without the mailed PIN, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the online payment flow.
